findings.reason: U+202F followed by U+0020 left a two-character gap before ':'. Corpus measured here: 249 values use U+202F immediately before ':' and 0 use U+202F+space. Fixed to U+202F+':' in all three.

'Inactif' was the only masculine form in a slot whose sibling statuses agree with 'session' (feminine), e.g. 'Terminée'. The fr corpus already uses the feminine with sessions ('sessions inactives', 'si la cible est inactive'). Now 'Inactive'.
Button label 'Reprendre' is now quoted '« Reprendre »' (U+00AB/U+202F/U+00BB), matching '« Nouvelle »' in list.empty_hint and the fr guide's quote policy.

19 cells vs maxCells 16, but the role is an accessible name only (no visible label, nothing to clip). 'Fermer' (6) fits the cap but strips the object for screen-reader and voice-control users. Kept; renderer/TTS confirmation deferred to the rendered QA pass.

Kept 'Tout marquer comme lu' at 21/20. The audit's own recommendation was to keep it; the safety audit's shorter 'Tout marquer lu' (15) is not idiomatic French ('marquer lu' has no valid construction; 'marquer comme lu' is the standard form, as in the fr corpus 'marqué comme prêt'). Accurate idiom retained over a misleading abbreviation; flagged for rendered fit.

Kept 'Désépingler' at 11/10; it is the standard French unpin term. Shorter 'Détacher' (8) was considered and rejected: it drops the pin metaphor and would not pair with the sibling 72 px tile label 'Épingler'. Flagged for the action-sheet/swipe-tile rendered check.

Kept 'Enregistrement…' at 15/12. 'Sauvegarde…' (11) fits but drifts from the guide's Enregistrer/Enregistré vocabulary and from the existing fr busy state 'enregistrement…' (relay.session.tags.saving). Flagged for rendered fit.
Kept 'Chargement de la conversation…' at 30/28. Bare 'Chargement…' fits but loses the object. Flagged for rendered fit in the centred loading state.
Same underlying issue as safety MAJ-04; fixed by that change (38 -> 30 cells against maxCells 32).
Present tense 'les envois attendent' keeps the wait sense and lands exactly on the 36-cell cap (was 37). No delivery/queue guarantee is asserted.

Ended banner was 38 cells vs maxCells 32. Per the wave instruction that French may shorten the banner while retaining 'history kept', the subject is dropped: 'Terminée · historique conservé' (30/32). 'Session finie · historique gardé' (32) was rejected as more colloquial ('finie').
'En attente de vous' read literary/translated; replaced with the native status form 'Vous attend' (11 cells vs cap 24). Same meaning: the session is waiting on the operator.

'Un envoi' nominalised 'a send'; now the verb form 'Envoyer un message ou « Reprendre » la rouvre dans votre dossier personnel'. The button word and 'dossier personnel' are preserved. No maxCells on this key.
Proposed 'Tout marquer lu' (15) is not grammatical French. Kept 'Tout marquer comme lu' (21/20) and flagged for rendered fit; see F05.

Width component fixed (37 -> 36, exactly at cap). The nominalisation rationale is rejected: 'envoi(s)' is this locale's settled noun for message sends, evidenced by relay.asks.status.delivering 'Répondu — envoi en cours' and wire.settings.send_journal_unconfirmed.label 'Journaliser les envois non acquittés'. The proposed 'envois en attente' was rejected because it states a queued state the English does not assert.
